title: Keep yourself company while you wait
script:
You do not have to make yourself stop caring. For now, look at the light near a window, or notice something familiar beside you. Let your attention rest there for a moment. Your breathing can stay just as it is.

That unanswered message has been taking up space in your mind. You want connection. You want to know where you stand. These are real needs, and they are allowed to matter.

At the same time, this silence cannot tell us its whole story yet. You can acknowledge that you do not know, without turning the uncertainty into a verdict about yourself. Your worth is larger than a notification on a screen.

If it feels right, set your phone a little farther away. Notice the temperature of your hands, or a sound in the room. While an answer is still missing, you can offer the waiting part of yourself a little care.

Perhaps that means some water, a stretch, or a conversation with someone you trust. You do not need to keep checking to prove how much this connection matters to you.

When you are ready, return your attention to the room. Later, you can express what kind of communication you need. For this small moment, you are allowed to have an evening that belongs to you.
